artworks.title: The Triumph of Galatea
artworks.description: This is a print of several people and creatures on the surface of the water. In the center of the print is a person partially draped in flowing cloth, their torso turned to the right and their head looking back to the left. They have long, flowing hair and their hands hold long reins attached to two large fish-like creatures that appear to pull a boat the person stands on. Around this person are several other people in the water, including a person on the far left who is riding a horse and blowing into a conch shell, a man with pointed ears and fin-like legs holding a woman by the waist, another man on the right blowing into what could be a trumpet, and a man with the front legs of a horse and a fish-like tail. In the bottom of the print, a cherub-like figure holds on to one of the fish pulling the central boat. More small, winged cherubs with bows and arrows fly above the scene, their arrows pointed at the central figure. The sky has a few small clouds blowing across it, and the water has small waves. At the bottom of the print are several lines of text.

artworks.title: Mr. Henricus van Born
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Lawrence Lawver
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man depicted from the waist up. He is sitting with one arm resting on a chair arm. The man has a round face, long curly hair, and is wearing a dark coat with large buttons and a white collar typical of 17th to 18th-century attire. No visible jewelry or objects are present. The background features an arched design, column, and sky with clouds. Below the image, text identifies the person as Mr. Henricus Van Born.

artworks.title: A Road through the Woods
artworks.description: The image depicts a forested landscape. The thick canopy of trees covers much of the upper half, with leaves and branches detailed through brushstrokes. Tall trees are on the left and right sides. In the middle distance, there is an opening between the trees with a person walking and another person on horseback further away. The color palette is monochromatic, focusing on light and dark contrast for depth.

artworks.title: Johan Gols [The Artist's Father]
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a bust portrait of a man in 16th-century attire. He is facing forward with a slight head turn. The man has a distinguished facial expression, with high cheekbones, a prominent nose, and deep-set eyes. His hair is short and thinning, and he sports a long beard. The man wears a robe or cloak with visible shoulder seams and decorative elements like a strap or chain. The portrait is framed in a circular medallion with intricate designs, including animals and scrollwork. Below the frame is an engraved panel with text in Gothic script and decorative elements. The background within the frame has a stippled texture.

artworks.title: Landscape with a Waterfall and a Resting Family
artworks.description: The image depicts a scene within a natural setting. The viewpoint is slightly elevated, showing a horizon with a castle-like structure and gentle hills in the distance. The artwork features a detailed etching or drawing technique with cross-hatching and stippling for texture and depth, especially seen in the foliage and tree bark. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of black and white for contrast and detail. In the foreground, two figures are sitting on grass near a cascading stream, with trees nearby and old ruins in the far distance.

artworks.title: Saint Mary Magdalene
artworks.artist: Raffaello Schiaminossi, after Lucas van Leyden
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Lawrence Lawver
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing in profile, facing right. She has long, wavy hair and delicate facial features. She wears a robe, holds a goblet in her left hand and a cloth in her right hand. There is a large halo-like circle behind her. The background has horizontal lines. Below the image is a text panel with inscriptions.

artworks.title: Memento Mori
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 12.9 × 15.8 cm (5 1/16 × 6 1/4 in.), cut within platemark
artworks.description: The image shows a baby lying down on its back, sleeping peacefully. The baby has closed eyes and a gentle expression, with soft hair covering its head. The baby is unclothed and rests on a fabric-covered surface. In the background, there is a large skull above the baby. The background is dark, emphasizing light on the child.

artworks.title: Ovindoli negli Abruzzi
artworks.medium: etching on chine collé [proof with etched remarques in the lower margin]
artworks.description: The image shows an elevated view of a landscape with a massive stone cliff supporting a fortified town. The horizon is partially obscured by clouds, emphasizing depth. Buildings and an arched bridge are visible against the skyline. The meticulous linework and hatching create texture and depth, emphasizing the rugged cliff and delicate buildings. The monochromatic image uses varying shades of grey to convey contrast and detail. Stone walls guide the eye upward to the town at the cliff's summit, which includes a tall tower. In the distance, rolling hills and settlements can be seen.

artworks.title: Colossaei. Ro. Prospectus. 3 (Third View of the Colosseum in Rome)
artworks.artist: Giovanni Battista Pittoni, after Hieronymus Cock
artworks.description: The image shows ancient ruins, possibly of an amphitheater or colosseum. The perspective is slightly elevated. The sky is prominent, with clouds and distant silhouettes. The ruins are detailed, showing crumbling stone and overgrown vegetation. The color palette is sepia against a blue background. In the foreground, a few figures are engaged in various activities. The style is intricate, using fine lines to depict the stone and clouds.

artworks.title: A Girl with a Crucifix
artworks.description: The image is an etching depicting a full-length view of a person shown from the back. The person stands slightly turned to the left, facing a wall with a detailed column. They have short hair with a wavy texture, and their facial features are subtle, viewed in profile from behind. The person is draped in long, flowing robes, with the fabric gathered around the waist and shoulders, showing folds and texture. They hold a tall cross in their right hand. The background features vertical lines that suggest a wall or drapery, with a detailed architectural element, possibly a column.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the gift of Dewayne and Faith Perry
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper half of a seated individual looking forward. The person has a composed face with arched eyebrows, clear eyes, and a subtle smile. Their hair is styled in a feathery cap-like manner. They are wearing a textured garment with fur trim. The person is holding a pen in their right hand over a piece of paper and there is an oval palette on the table in front of them. Next to the palette, there is a book or books partially visible. The background is a neutral textured surface.

artworks.title: Midas, Transmuting All into Paper
artworks.medium: etching with publisher's hand-coloring in watercolor on laid paper
artworks.description: This caricature shows a pink-skinned man with long, spindly arms, widely straddled legs, and a bulbous, potbellied torso blowing scraps of paper with puffed cheeks in this vertical, colored etching. He stands with his body facing us, hands planted near his hips, but he turns his narrow head to our right in profile as he blows out the slips of paper. Tall ass’s ears flank a red crown plastered with more scraps of paper. The papers on the crown and being blown out of the man’s pursed lips all read “one.” The man’s long, pointed nose and rotund cheeks are bright red, and lank, light brown hair brushes his neck. Eyebrows are arched over heavy-lidded eyes. His rounded belly is made up of yellow disks, possibly coins, that also reach up his long, thin neck. A cursive letter “L,” the symbol for a British pound, is written on the belly. A padlock hangs from a chain around his neck, bearing the words, “Power of securing Public Credit.” His long fingers hook around either side of his torso. A yellow skeleton key with a tag reading, “Key of Public Property” hangs from his left pinky finger, to our right. His arms are covered in blue sleeves with yellow buttons at the cuffs, and a scarlet-red cloak with yellow epaulets hangs over his arms and swirls around his shins. His feet are planted wide and he wears parchment-colored, knee-length britches, light blue stockings, and black shoes with buckles. He straddles a miniature view into a building labeled the “BANK OF ENGLAND,” where coins and slips of paper rain down from the ceiling. Tiny in scale, about two dozen men wearing dark hats and coats in brown, blue, red, or green look up and gesture toward the ceiling. At the center of the room is a domed structure about the height of the men. To our left of the main caricatured man and near his leg, five heads emerge from a bank of reedy grass. Each head has a red cap, and a white speech bubble angling from each mouth reads, “Midas has Ears.” Beyond the grass and heads, turquoise water leads back to a shoreline with a sign reading “BREST” and a flag striped horizontally with red, white, and blue. To our right, near the man’s waist, three miniature, light-skinned men with round faces and paunchy bellies float around a banner. Cloaks affixed around their necks flutter around their otherwise nude bodies, and they raise their hats high above their heads with one hand. The banner reads, “Prosperous state of British finances and the new plan for diminishing the national debt with hints on the increase of commerce.” The sky above these vignettes has a band of blue clouds. The paper being blown from the man’s mouth fills the upper right corner of the paper but in the upper left, touches of light blue beneath peach-colored dots suggest countless angels or bodies shooting into the sky. Under the border around the printed image, across the bottom, and inscription reads, “MIDAS, Transmuting all into GOLD PAPER,” and the word “GOLD” has been crossed out with overlapping, diagonal lines. The inscription continues below: “History of Midas, The great Midas having dedicated himself to Bacchus, obtained from that Deity, the power of changing all he Touched — Apollo fixed Asses Ears upon his head, for his Ignorance & although he tried to hide his disgrace with a Regal Cap, yet the very Sedges which grew from the Mud of the Pactolus, whispered out his Infamy, whenever they were agitated by the Wind from the opposite Shore __ Vide Ovids Metamorpho,” the last word fading out. In smaller letters, the work is inscribed “Js. Gy. inv & ft” under the lower left corner of the image, and “Pub. March 9th 1797 by H. Humphrey New Bond Street” under the lower right corner.

artworks.title: L'entrée au musée (Entrance to the Museum)
artworks.medium: etching with publisher's hand coloring in watercolor on pale green laid paper
artworks.description: The image is a painting of a crowded museum entrance scene. The group of people tightly packed together are trying to enter a museum. The individuals are dressed in early 19th-century period clothing, including top hats, long overcoats, and dresses. The chaotic scene shows people pushing and leaning to gain entry. Framed paintings hang on the wall behind the crowd, and the colors are bright. The illustration style is caricature-like, emphasizing the bustling event.

artworks.title: Provinciaux visitant les curiosités de Paris (Provinicials Visiting the Curiosities of Paris)
artworks.medium: etching with publisher's hand coloring in watercolor on pale green laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts multiple figures in exaggerated clothing outdoors. The figures have oversized collars, elongated hats, and voluminous skirts. They are standing in front of a stone wall with arched windows. One figure leans forward dramatically. The scene has a humorous tone. The text at the bottom reads "Provinciaux Visitant les Curiosités de Paris."

artworks.title: Les Invisibles en tête-à-tête (Tête-à-Tête with Poke Bonnets)
artworks.medium: etching with publisher's hand coloring in watercolor on pale green laid paper

artworks.title: A Swiss Cottage
artworks.description: This black and white illustration features a Swiss cottage at the center, surrounded by foliage and mountains in the background. The style shows detailed linework and textures of trees, stone paths, and shrubs. A stone path leads to the cottage, with a small fence and a couple in traditional attire walking towards it. The color scheme is grayscale, emphasizing the detailed textures of natural elements and architectural features of the cottage.

artworks.title: A Coast Road with Cliffs in the North of France
artworks.description: The drawing depicts a landscape seen from an elevated point, showing water and land with a structure on a hill. There are figures, a post or tree by the water, and a simple color scheme with neutral and gray tones.

artworks.title: Diana and Two Nymphs Receiving Gifts from a Satyr (recto)
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink over black chalk, heightened with white, on brown laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures under a tree. The central composition features a satyr-like figure on the left holding a fabric with fruits. To the right, there is a reclining figure and another figure engaged in conversation. In the background, a smaller figure with a curious expression is watching. The sketch showcases expressive line work with a classic style.

artworks.title: Diana and Four Nymphs Receiving Gifts from a Satyr
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray wash over black chalk, heightened with white gouache, on brown laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of six figures interacting in an outdoor setting. One figure is seated wearing a crown and holding a staff, while the others are gathered around in a semicircle. One figure is kneeling over a pile of objects. The figures are dressed in classical-style robes. The drawing is in shades of grey, creating depth and shading. The figures' clothing and postures suggest movement and interaction.

artworks.title: Le portraict de tres-haut...Henry Le Grand (Henri IV on His Deathbed)
artworks.description: The image shows a man reclining on a decorated bed within an elaborately detailed interior. He is positioned on his back with his head resting on multiple embroidered pillows, and his arms are raised with open palms. He wears a crown and is dressed in a robe adorned with a fleur-de-lis pattern, along with a high collar. A scepter rests beside him. The bed is surrounded by draped curtains, and the room has richly patterned walls featuring heraldic symbols. Books rest on tables flanking the bed, and tall candles are placed around the room. The background reveals tall archways and a glimpse of a building through an open window. The image borders are decorated with Latin text and ornaments.

artworks.title: The Baptism of Christ
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a group of people in a dramatic scene. Various figures are shown at different angles, emphasizing different parts of their bodies. One person stands with torso exposed, pointing upwards, with flowing hair. Nearby, another person kneels shirtless, with tied-back hair and looking up. Another figure holds an infant while draped in fabric, with long hair flowing. Other figures around them are in different postures, also gazing upwards. One person holds a container from which water cascades. The people are dressed in flowing garments reminiscent of a classical style. The background includes natural elements like trees, a river, distant mountains, and a dove emitting light from the clouds. An inscription is visible below the illustration.

artworks.title: Jupiter and Mercury Entertained by Philemon and Baucis
artworks.description: The image shows a black and white etching of four individuals. There is a seated man on the left, with his upper body exposed, leaning on a chair and gesturing towards the table. Beside him, an older man leans forward holding a basket of fruit. In the center-back, a second seated man is viewed from behind, holding a cup. In front of him is a bird. To the right, a standing woman looks towards the group with her arm outstretched. The background features a wooden beam ceiling, a shelf with jugs, and a window with lattice-pane detailing.

artworks.title: A Satyr Visiting a Peasant Family
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene in a rustic setting with mythical and earthly figures gathered around a table. The central composition shows a satyr seated at the table with other figures engaged in various activities. On the right, a woman holds a child. A dog sits under the table. The background includes an interior with shelves and a rooster near a window. The caption below is in Latin. The drawing is detailed with cross-hatched shading.
